text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
De~gi~ta~l-san♪ If I recall correctly, you 
mentioned before that you've watched my 
stream?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So... there's something I'd like to ask 
you—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Because you watched the stream!? 
Something you want to ask!? N-N-No way, 
did she find out that Digi-tan is a 
hardcore Loves listener!?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm thinking of hosting a fan 
meeting with my overseas fans soon♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm having trouble deciding on a 
plan... I was hoping to get some input 
from someone who's close with 
international Umamusume fans♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, umm~... I wonder if someone like 
Digi-tan can really be of any help to 
Loves-san~.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I saw the report posted on social media 
about the meetup with the overseas fans.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because you can interact with so much 
love, I knew I wanted to ask you. ...I 
believe in your love, Digital-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My fave's love factor has pierced the 
heavens~~~~~!! It's too radiant, I can't 
look directly at ittt!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ah, excuse me. That phrasing just 
reminded me of listener "Pink Tail" who 
used it too♡

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I-Is that sooo??? I have absolutely no 
idea who that is! Hahaha! 
........................*phew*...!!
